sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was raised materially: Q2 net sales guided to $194B-$199B and operating income to $20B-$24B, both above the prior quarter's results. AWS growth accelerated to 28% (fastest in three years) with a $364B backlog before the $100B+ Anthropic deal, and operating margin hit a record 13.1%. Cost pressures (memory, transport, LEO) are flagged but described as manageable next to the strong demand and monetization of capex.

summary.revenue: $181.5B, up 17% year over year, 15% excluding currency.
summary.guidance: Q2 net sales guided to $194B to $199B and operating income $20B to $24B.
summary.margin: Operating income $23.9B at a 13.1% margin, the highest ever.
key_risks: Memory component costs have skyrocketed and supply volatility threatens capacity.
Higher transport and fuel costs plus about $1B of LEO expense pressure Q2 margins.
Rapid capex growth constrains free cash flow until the infrastructure monetizes.
key_opportunities: AWS is now a $150 billion annualized revenue run rate business, growing at 28% (fastest in more than three years).
Trainium2 chip has about 30% better price performance than comparable GPUs.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Jassy describes AWS growth as 'very unusual for a business to grow this fast on a base this large,' and the prepared remarks highlight a record operating margin and accelerating AWS growth.
